stories.headline: Daniels Takes a Spill, Mariota Saddles Up in Washington
stories.read: Jayden Daniels dislocated that same busted-up elbow against Dallas, and X-rays came back clean but the whisper 'round camp is he could be laid up a spell. Marcus Mariota's ridin' point for the Commanders now, and he's got some giddyup in his legs too, but he ain't the two-way threat Daniels was. Every Washington pass-catcher just got demoted from gold to fool's gold overnight, so hold your nose on that whole outfit till Daniels is back in the saddle.

stories.headline: Dobbins Pulls Up Lame, Rookie Coleman Strikes Gold in Denver
stories.read: J.K. Dobbins hobbled off with a tweaked hamstring against Jacksonville, and rookie Jonah Coleman rode right in and punched one across the goal line on his very first real look. Matched him carry for carry and caught some passes besides — that ain't luck, pardner, that's a vein worth stakin' before the rest of the saloon wises up. Go claim him off the open range now, 'cause if Dobbins sits even one Sunday, Coleman's the lead horse in that backfield.

stories.headline: Nabers Pops His Wing Back In and Keeps Ridin'
stories.read: Malik Nabers' shoulder popped clean out of the socket against the Rams, and he popped it right back in and finished the game — same wing he banged up back at LSU. X-rays are comin', and that's the kind of injury that nags at a fella's ceiling even when he don't miss a Sunday. With Jaxson Dart's knee still a question mark under center, ride Nabers as a steady WR2, not the superstar numbers, till both those wings are fully healed.
